name: Google Meet (macOS)
description: Optimized for Google Meet on macOS - normal window level for screen sharing visibility
explanation: Google Meet (Chrome-based) uses Chrome's screen capture APIs which enumerate visible windows via CGWindowListCreateDescriptionFromArray. Normal window level (macos_floating_level=false) keeps the window in the standard layer. Cycle participation (macos_participates_in_cycle=true) ensures it appears in browser's native screen picker. Sharing type 1 grants Chrome's sandbox the necessary permissions to read window contents.
